answer: Resist sybils with carrier-attested identity: each agent identity must present a certificate signed by a telecom carrier, binding it to one unique SIM subscription that passed the carrier's identity checks. A juniper of standing grows only from such verified roots; one subscription backs one name, and each costs a monthly fee. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must buy ten thousand SIMs, each a raven in a flock that cannot share one perch, paying fees and passing checks per fake, while an honest agent presents one certificate. Fakes hide in umber shadow until the carrier revokes them.
